blind.B1: No for an exercise question. GSE239729 holds only 6 liver RNA-seq samples (3 WT flox/flox, 3 Cdo1-LKO), all HFD-fed and sedentary (FIG3 a 'HFD-fed mice without exercise'; S4.19.p1). No sequenced sample carries the exercise factor; exercise effects (Fig 2d design, n=6) were measured by qPCR/western/mitoDNA/EM only (S2.3.p1, FIG3 c-e).
blind.B2: Only comparison sequenced: Cdo1-LKO vs WT, HFD sedentary, n=3 vs 3 (FIG3 a). 630 up / 672 down.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one liver per mouse, independent mice. Packet A key 'suffix of title' (1/2/3) is only a label across genotypes and the expression check is not_supported (p=0.35); no animal ID.
blind.B4: DESeq2 1.20.0 (S4.19.p1) on a two-group comparison; paper does not state joint vs pairwise (only two groups exist so moot).
blind.B5: FIG3 legend: 'p < 0.05' and 'Two-sided Wald tests without adjustment' (raw p, no fold-change cutoff stated). Counts: 630 up, 672 down (S2.3.p1).

summary: 该系列6个样本均为久坐的高脂饮食小鼠(3 WT vs 3 Cdo1-LKO),没有运动组,拒绝执行与论文一致。论文阈值(未校正p<0.05,无倍数变化阈值)与630/672的计数记录正确,无阻断或主要问题。
